---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's the use case? A clear description of why
this would be valuable.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to happen. Be as concrete as you can.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you didn't choose them.

## Scope / impact

- Which component would this touch? (orchestrator / website / agent image / templates / docs)
- Would it require a database migration or a new environment variable?

## Additional context

Mockups, links, or anything else that helps explain the request.
